_doc: Clinic life (ClinicLifeManager): small things that happen while the clock moves, shown as a caption in the room. needs: staff (an employee at this clinic, {staff}), waiting (someone in the waiting room, {patient}), periods, min_heat. effects: supplies, parts, money, dims, heat, stress (all staff here), patience (waiting room, minutes). Weights, not rules. Also the waiting room rules and the Clinic Wall.

vignettes.text: {staff} eats cold noodles over the sink between patients.
{staff} brews something that smells like coolant and calls it coffee.
{patient} has fallen asleep on the bench, mouth open, chrome ticking.
{patient} tells nobody in particular about the first time they got chromed.
{patient} complains loudly about the wait and the smell.
A fixer smokes in the alley outside, watching who comes and goes.
A courier drops a crate of sterile packs on the step and doesn't wait for a signature.
Someone leaves a bag of salvaged servos by the door. No note.
{staff} re-solders the flickering lamp with the patient tray as a ladder.
Shouting outside. A bottle breaks. Then nothing.
The pipe over the table drips again. Somebody puts a cup under it.
A patrol drone hovers at the window a little too long.
A kid presses their face to the glass, staring at the chrome on the shelf.
The power dips. The monitors reboot one by one, complaining.
{staff} laughs at something on their deck. First time today.
